mg996r.source: TowerPro MG996R datasheet (towerpro.com.tw), standard-size 40x20 RC servo: 4 mounting-tab holes, nominal 4.5 mm, on a 10.0 x 49.5 mm rectangle

nema17.source: NEMA ICS 16-2001 size 17 frame (e.g. StepperOnline 17HS4401 datasheet): 42.3 mm faceplate, 4x M3 clearance holes on a 31.0 mm square

nema23.source: NEMA ICS 16-2001 size 23 frame (e.g. StepperOnline 23HS22-2804S datasheet): 56.4 mm faceplate, 4x M5 clearance holes on a 47.14 mm square

608.source: ISO 15 / DIN 625-1 deep-groove ball bearing 608 (SKF 608 datasheet): 8 mm bore x 22 mm OD x 7 mm width; mount is a 22.0 mm diameter seat bore

fan_60mm.source: 60 mm frame axial fan (e.g. Noctua NF-A6x25, Sunon EE60 series datasheets): 4x M4 clearance holes on a 50.0 mm square mounting pitch

ext_2020.source: 20x20 T-slot aluminium extrusion (e.g. Misumi HFS5-2020, 80/20 20-series catalogs): M5 fastening via slot T-nut or tapped center bore; bracket requires one M5 clearance hole per attachment point

raspberry_pi_4.source: Raspberry Pi 4 Model B official mechanical drawing (raspberrypi.com): 4x 2.7 mm holes on a 58.0 x 49.0 mm rectangle, M2.5 fasteners
